excerpts.line: Welcome to the Office of the President
window: Welcome to the Office of the President
We’re excited to support you on your educational journey. Whether you’re attending classes on campus, online, or both, we’re here to help you reach your academic and career goals.

Explore our degrees, certificates, and career options through our interactive Learning & Career Pathways. Need tech support? Visit our Student Tech Support or stop by the Library for Chromebook checkouts and other technology resources. Don’t forget, we offer campus-wide free Wi-Fi!

excerpts.line: Laney College President
window: We look forward to seeing you at Laney College—on campus or online!

Laney College and the Peralta Colleges remain committed to supporting undocumented students and their families. This page provides important information about recent California laws protecting immigrant communities, campus resources available to undocumented students, and access to legal, mental health, and wellness support services. Resources are available in multiple languages to help ensure our community has the information and assistance needed to feel safe, supported, and empowered.
